does_not_do: It is a research codebase built around notebooks rather than a packaged library, and it ships no evaluated, ready-to-use model of its own here.
focus_reason: Useful as reference material, but no test workflow runs and the code is largely notebooks. One release in the year; 35 open issues.
measured_against: Need: an open-source starting point for language models on financial text.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; the only GitHub workflow triages issues.
what_it_is: An open-source project for financial large language models: notebooks and scripts for fine-tuning open models on financial data, with released models on Hugging Face.
